Two wake-ups at 19 months is common but fixable — the usual culprit is Remy learning to fall back asleep independently rather than needing you there. Try a consistent wind-down that ends with him drowsy but awake in the crib, so he practices that skill from the start of the night and can reuse it mid-night.

Want the full night-by-night sleep plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
